description: Fields of Crossref records that are known to be wrong, checked against the publication itself. check_references.py does not compare these fields.

exceptions.reason: Crossref gives the family name as 'Richard Shewchuk'. The article's author is Jonathan Richard Shewchuk, family name Shewchuk.
Crossref lists only the two editors, P. Bryan and M. Nottingham. RFC 6901 names K. Zyp as its second author.
